'''Queneth Li''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who left his [[Voss|homeworld]] to accompany the [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Talsa-ko]], who joined the [[New Empire]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] at the behest of [[Darth Serevin]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Queneth Li fought alongside Serevin when the New Empire's base at [[Fort Barrow]] was overrun, and was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Queneth Li appears as a supporting enemy to Darth Serevin, the final boss in the Flashpoint "The Battle of Ilum" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Unlike virtually all other Voss, Queneth Li lacks a hyphen in his name.<ref name="TOR" />
